qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Board-level spec-in lock-in across >75,000 SKUs and >125,000 diversified customers. Analog ICs represent a negligible fraction (<1-2%) of customer system BoM but are catastrophic to system failure, creating insurmountable switching costs and multi-million-dollar redesign/recertification hurdles. Gross margins are structurally sustained at 65-70% (adjusted ~68-70%) and trough adjusted operating margins remain >40%. Operating/tangible ROIC exceeds 60-190%+, while GAAP ROIC is optically deflated by non-cash merger amortization from Linear Tech and Maxim. Primary long-term erosion risks include customer in-house ASIC design at high volumes, low-end Asian analog commoditization, and cyclical inventory corrections.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global high-performance analog and mixed-signal duopolist (ADI + Linear + Maxim) with mission-critical board-level spec-in lock-in across industrial, automotive, and communications infrastructure. Structurally insulated from or actively benefiting from all 5 macrotrends via factory automation, EV battery management systems, AI data center power stages, and a resilient hybrid manufacturing model. Highly cash-generative with 138% multi-year FCF conversion and net debt repayable in ~1.4 years of Owner FCF. [5-10Y g: industrial/auto/datacenter volume 4.5% + pricing/mix 1.5% + operating leverage 0.5% + net share repurchases 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle financial track record demonstrates exceptional compounding: sales grew from $3.4B in FY16 to $11.0B in FY25, with peak Owner EPS advancing from $5.47 (FY18) to $8.59 (FY23) and trough EPS holding at $6.03 (FY24). Gross margins consistently range between 65% and 70%. Multi-year Owner FCF conversion is 138% of GAAP Net Income ($3.96B FCF in FY25 vs $2.27B NI), reflecting heavy non-cash intangible amortization ($2.0B D&A) from the Linear Technology and Maxim Integrated acquisitions. Operating/tangible ROIC consistently exceeds 60% (192% in FY23, 63% in FY25). Segment breakdown (FY25): Industrial 45%, Automotive 30%, Communications/Datacenter 13%, Consumer 13%. Balance sheet is solid with $2.5B cash against $8.1B long-term debt; net debt of $5.6B is covered by ~1.4 years of Owner FCF, and EBIT/interest coverage stands at 9.2x.
